Warehouse Employee 
As a Warehouse Employee, you ensure that orders leave the warehouse on time, complete, and correct. You work in a structured manner, are physically strong, and have an eye for detail. In this position, you are an important part of the logistics process within a growing organization. 
Salary 
 € 15.76 
Location 
 Oss 
Sector 
 Wholesale 
Employment type 
 Full-time 
 What will you do? 
In this position, you will be fully involved in warehouse operations. Using an EPT and hand scanner, you will work independently to collect orders. The scanner will guide you flawlessly through the warehouse, and it will be your job to stack everything accurately and securely onto pallets that can sometimes be up to 2.2 meters high. Physical work does not deter you: bags weighing up to 25 kilos are no problem for you, and you understand the importance of safe and correct lifting. 
You will usually work independently, but you will help out when colleagues need assistance. Do you see room for improvement in the process? Then you are encouraged to discuss this with the warehouse manager. Your insight contributes directly to the growth and professionalization of the organization. 
 The offer
